'''Cullen Burns Hunt Down DS''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Cullen Burns]] posted on DeckTech. The published title is not used as the page title; it appears in the original post below.<ref name="dt-12798">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12798 DeckTech post 12798], DeckTech (Cullen "Sigmar" Burns, 10 January 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/12798/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/12798/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018074655/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/12798/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cullen Burns]]
* '''Published:''' 10 January 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HD Burns DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits what are you trying to push on us: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' nice ho

The post also lists 2x what are you trying to push on us, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.
